newsitem.title: UK: Price Waterhouse in Korea consultancy jv with CSG.
newsitem.headline: Price Waterhouse in Korea consultancy jv with CSG.

text.p: Price Waterhouse (PW), the U.S.-based accounting and consultancy group, said on Monday its management consultancy arm had formed a joint venture in South Korea with locally-based independent consultants CSG.
"Our joint venture will meet a booming demand for consulting in a market growing at double digit rates," Scott Hartz, managing partner of PW Global Management Consulting said in a statement.

The move will create an organisation of 140 people in South Korea and the country's largest IT and management consultancy firm, PW said, adding it formed part of a strategy to seek aggressive growth around the world to support global clients.
